commands.label: help
commands.output:
usage: ak820.py [-h]
                [--profile {main,game,mmo,typing,code,pointer,onehand,creative,shortcuts,multios}]
                {diagnose,setup,udev,prepare,install,verify,check-device,recover,update-prepared,backup,restore,update}
                ...

AK820 Linux/Windows installer. No command: HID enumeration only.

positional arguments:
  {diagnose,setup,udev,prepare,install,verify,check-device,recover,update-prepared,backup,restore,update}
    diagnose            List HID interfaces without opening devices, reset or
                        firmware writes
    setup               Local Python environment and hidapi; no USB access
    udev                Configure Linux device access without USB reset
    prepare             Create personal permanent/recovery session without
                        reset/erase/flash
    install             Fresh OEM backup, explicit confirmations, permanent
                        install, typing and CODE readback
    verify              Verify release files and approval entirely offline; no
                        HID access
    check-device        Check running firmware without writing settings
    recover             Restore personal OEM backup from an existing loader;
                        no reset sent
    update-prepared     Reviewed RC6 repair; fresh physical Esc + left Ctrl
                        consent
    backup              Validated local settings backup
    restore             Validated local settings restore
    update              Validated local settings update

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --profile {main,game,mmo,typing,code,pointer,onehand,creative,shortcuts,multios}
                        Exact installer profile (default: main)
